approach: Original PS4 x86-64 game code running directly on Windows and Linux through replacement PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4
notes: Public native Windows release with an experimental Linux/Steam Deck AppImage. Supports the USA base package (CUSA05083 1.00) with its 1.01 update, the Japanese base (CUSA01290 1.00) with its 1.02 update, the European base (CUSA05262 1.00) with its 1.01 update and both CUSA03873 1.00 packages (Hong Kong and Asia). Includes the TRG launcher and package installer, Portuguese (Brazil) and English menus and subtitles, native cheats, controller rebinding, render resolutions up to 4K, ultrawide aspect ratios, FSR 1 and RCAS, SMAA, GPU selection, experimental OpenGL and Direct3D 11 renderers, Xbox controller prompts, local trophies, Skip intro, a self-updater and portable user data. No game files are included.
